top5.title: Jensen Huang reportedly prepared crisis management ahead of personal revelation
top5.description: According to Wired, the Nvidia chief reportedly hired a scandal-specialist agency at least a year before acknowledging an affair with a former Megaspeed executive. Nvidia’s board has launched an independent investigation into the company’s possible ties to China.
top5.why: Nvidia’s board investigation into potential China ties and CEO-related governance issues could affect investor confidence, leadership stability, and the geopolitics of the AI-chip market.

top5.title: OpenAI reportedly raising $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
top5.description: OpenAI has reportedly secured $11 billion in a round that could reach $20 billion, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion. The deal, smaller than expected, comes amid increased scrutiny of infrastructure spending and AI profitability.
top5.why: OpenAI’s reported $11 billion financing at a $1.25 trillion valuation signals both the extraordinary capital intensity of frontier AI and growing scrutiny over whether that spending can generate sustainable returns.

top5.title: Google adds two specialized chips to its TPU 8 lineup
top5.description: The TPU 8tx encrypts sensitive data while it is being processed, while the TPU 8i Max doubles computing power and memory by combining two chips. Google now has nearly 100 external customers for its TPUs.
top5.why: Google’s new TPU variants strengthen its vertically integrated challenge to Nvidia while expanding secure and higher-capacity AI infrastructure for nearly 100 external customers.

top5.title: Apple wants to turn Siri into a more autonomous assistant
top5.description: Apple is working to make Siri an assistant capable of pursuing goals, deciding on next steps, and independently carrying out certain tasks. The change could arrive as early as next year, according to Bloomberg.
top5.why: Apple’s planned shift toward an autonomous, goal-oriented Siri could reshape the company’s product strategy and intensify competition to make AI assistants operational rather than merely conversational.

top5.title: Companies remain responsible for their AI agents’ mistakes
top5.description: Four UK regulators have warned that organizations remain responsible for the autonomous AI agents they deploy.
top5.why: Warnings from four UK regulators make clear that companies remain legally responsible for mistakes made by autonomous AI agents, raising the compliance and deployment stakes for enterprise adopters.
